name: Autonomous tenant
short_description: An architectural pattern described in the episode in which a Microsoft 365 tenant acts as a unified control plane, with Entra ID for identity policy, Dataverse for business state, Power Automate for orchestration and Copilot Studio for intent, so that processes run deterministically without human operators in the data flow.

evidence.quote: The autonomous tenant treats these components as a single integrated substrate
Three specific pillars support the autonomous tenant.
